category: shared seedbox with media stack (French market)

free_tier.stated: No free tier and no free trial is published. The no-risk path is the refund window: 'Satisfait ou remboursé 14 jours' with 'Sans engagement'.
free_tier.notes: the page read lists 1 To at EUR 12.00 HT/month; no trial length, no free bytes, no restock statement

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: sold by total storage, from 500 Go to 15 To; no largest-single-file cap is published

retention.stated: for the life of the subscription; no inactivity deletion is stated

egress.terms: 'Debit illimite: Aucune restriction de bande passante' and 'Slots illimites' on a shared 100 Gbps network. No monthly byte figure and no throttle threshold are published anywhere on the page read.
egress.free_allowance: unlimited claimed; no byte figure published

interface_detail: 'Acces WebDAV, FTP et navigateur web integre' for the storage side; the media stack is browser-driven.
tooling: WebDAV mount, FTP client, built-in file browser; one-click Prowlarr/Radarr/Sonarr/Jellyseerr/Jellyfin stack; no rclone or CLI is documented
chaining: A French-market box that pairs a 1 TB WebDAV mount with a preconfigured arr stack; the EUR 12 HT entry is above the USD 5 line, so it prices the paid tier rather than answering the free question

limits.value: 100 Gbps shared across the server; no per-account rate is published

limits_note: The page claims unlimited throughput with no restriction, which cannot be verified without an account.
binding_note: Nothing in the vocabulary fails at 1 TiB/month: there is no byte quota, no object cap and no published rate limit. The binding fact is price (EUR 12 HT for 1 To, EUR 14.40 TTC at 20% VAT), which the vocabulary does not name.

identity_cost.detail: An account and a payment method are required; no free tier exists. The page advertises French-language support and 20 years of operation, but states no identity document or phone check.

reliability_note: Unlimited bandwidth is a vendor claim with no published fair-use threshold; a client pulling 1 TiB/month has no stated protection if that claim changes.
confidence_note: Price, storage range, protocols and refund window are on the live tariff page read. The unlimited-traffic claim would need a paid account and a transfer run to reach measured.

evidence.proved: 1 To at EUR 12.00 HT/month (0.0120 EUR HT/Go), 'Debit illimite / Aucune restriction de bande passante', 'Slots illimites', 100 Gbps shared, 14-day refund, 500 Go to 15 To range
'Acces WebDAV, FTP et navigateur web integre'; one-click Prowlarr/Radarr/Sonarr/Jellyseerr/Jellyfin stack; Plex and Jellyfin streaming

price_per_tb_month: EUR 12.00 HT per 1 To per month (EUR 12/TB/month; EUR 14.40 TTC at 20% VAT)
notes: The price is quoted hors taxe; a French or EU consumer pays VAT on top, so the comparable figure is 14.40 EUR TTC. Sustained-rate conversion: 1 TB/month = 10^12/(30x86,400) = 385,802 B/s = 3.09 Mbit/s. The page publishes no threshold, so the claim stays unverified rather than refuted.

extras.sustained_mbps_from_allowance: unlimited claimed; 1 TiB/month would need 3.39 Mbit/s
extras.apps: Plex, Jellyfin, Prowlarr, Radarr, Sonarr, Jellyseerr, Nextcloud, Seafile, Immich, PyLoad, Resilio, Kavita, OpenVPN
extras.vat_note: 12.00 EUR HT -> 14.40 EUR TTC at the French 20% rate
